title: Identifying Prognostic Factors in Brain Metastasis Patients Using MRI Morphological Features: A Machine Learning and Survival Analysis Approach.
summary: In 109 single-center brain-metastasis patients, a shallow neural network using clinical and MRI morphology features achieved AUC 0.93 for six-month survival on a 22-patient patient-level temporal holdout. This is exploratory, treatment-conditional prediction, not causal treatment evidence. The result is reported in the Diagnostics. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: Four ML models (XGBoost, shallow NN, KNN and RF) compared patient variables, MRI morphology, and both together for six-month survival
